code:
make run FILE=tests/fibonacci.ml    # run one file
make test                           # run all tests
make generate-expected              # regenerate expected/ directory
make clean                          # remove __pycache__ directories
description: The four commands the Makefile gives you, one per target.

steps.description: The page says the Makefile gives every contributor a single consistent interface, so these commands work the same way for everyone.
`make generate-expected` regenerates the `expected/` directory, and `make clean` removes `__pycache__` directories.

title: Using the Makefile
